'''Daimar Intelligence''' was an intelligence organization that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Daimar]] during the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sliver (Human)|Sliver]] worked for Daimar Intelligence and during the course of his employment, he carried out intelligence gathering, sabotage and [[Assassin/Legends|assassinations]], with his primary duties being to investigate threats to Daimar's security, and to protect the world's [[Lamont Dynasty of Daimar|royal family]].<ref name="Flames of Rebellion" />
